chapter.verse: Hih thute khit ciangin Pasian in Abraham ze-et a, ama kiangah, “Abraham!” ci hi. Amah in, “Hiah om ing,” ci hi.
Amah in, “Na it, na tapa khat bek ahi Isaak, la in la Moriah gamah pai in, tua lai mun-a nang' kiangah kong gen ding mual khat tungah meihal biak piakna-in amah hong pia in,” ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin zingsangin Abraham tho baih a, a la tutphah vawhin, ama' mihingte tangval nih leh a tapa Isaak paipih hi; amah in meihal biak piak nadingin sing ek a, ama' tunga Pasian’ gen sa munah pai hi.
A ni thum ni ciangin Abraham khuadak to-in a gamla-ah tua mun mu hi.
Tua ciangin Abraham in a tangvalte' kiangah, “Hi lai-ah la tawh na om un; kei leh tangvalpa hua lamah pai-in ka va bia ding uh a, note kiangah ka hong paikik ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Abraham in meihal biakna sing la-in a tapa Isaak’ tungah suan hi; amah in a khut sungah mei leh temta tawi hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute gel paikhawm uh hi.
Isaak in a pa Abraham kiangah, “Pa aw,” ci hi. Amah in, “Hiah om ing, ka ta,” ci hi. Amah in, “En in, mei leh sing om hi; ahih hangin meihal biakpiak nadingin tuuno koi-ah om ahi hiam?” ci hi.
Abraham in, “Pasian in meihal biakpiak nadingin ama ading tuuno hong pia ding hi, ka ta aw,” ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute gel paikhawm uh hi.

Ama' kiangah Pasian’ gennasa mun amaute a tun’ uh ciangin, Abraham in tua lai-ah biakna tau khat bawlin, a ngei nading bangin sing koihin, a tapa x Isaak henin biakna tau tunga sing tungah amah koih hi.
Tua ciangin Abraham in a tapa that dingin tem la hi.
Ahih hangin Topa ’ vantungmi in vantung panin, “Abraham, Abraham!” ci-in amah sam hi. Amah in, “Hiah om ing,” ci hi.

Amah in, “Tangvalpa su kei in, ama' tungah bangmah hih kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh nang in Pasian na zahtakna tu-in ka thei a, na tapa, na tapa khat bek ahi, keima adingin na humcip lohna ka mu hi,” ci hi.
Abraham in a lu phongto-in khuadak hi, en in, khaumang lakah a ki-a a awk tuutal khat a nungah om hi; Abraham pai-in tuutal kai a, ama tapa, tangin meihal biak piakna-in pia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Abraham in tua mun pen, tu ni dongin, “ Topa ’ mual tungah hong kisikh ding hi,” a kicih mah bangin, Topa in hong sikh ding, ci hi.
Topa ’ vantungmi in vantung panin Abraham a nih veina sam a,
“Keimahmah ka kiciam hi, Topa in ci hi, bang hang hiam cih leh nang in hih thu na bawl khin a, na tapa, na tapa khat bek na humcip kei hi,
nang thupha kong pia taktak ding hi, na suan-le-khakte van-a aksite leh tuipi gei-a sehnel bangin tampi ka phasak ding hi. Na suan-le-khakte in amau’ galte’ khuapite luah ding uh a,
na suan-le-khakte thupha ka piak bangin, leitung minam khempeuh in thupha a ngah nadingun hong ngen ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh nang in ka thu na mang hi,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tangvalte’ kiangah Abraham ciahkik a, Be-ersheba-ah paikhawm uh hi; Abraham Be-ersheba-ah teng hi.
Hih thute khit ciangin Abraham kiangah, “En in, Milkah in zong na sanggampa Nahor tawh tate nei hi:
Uz in a u pen hi, a sanggamte in Buz, Aram’ pa Kemuel,
Khesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaf leh Bethuel ahi hi,” kici hi.
Bethuel in Rebekah’ pa ahi hi. Milkah in Abraham’ sanggam Nahor tawh hih mihing giatte nei hi.
Tua tham loin Reumah min nei a zi-neu in ta Tebah, Gaham, Tahash leh Ma-akah nei hi.
